items.title: Forced uv cache clean during a concurrent upgrade
items.detail: The updater has no mutual exclusion; a second tool start during an upgrade runs uv cache clean --force mid-install. Check: scratch UV_CACHE_DIR/UV_TOOL_DIR, start uv tool upgrade of a small tool, loop uv cache clean --force on it, 20 rounds; if any round breaks the tool, serialize clean+upgrade with a lock file in state_dir.

items.title: Cache clean may be redundant for uv-tool and uv-venv
items.detail: uv pip install --upgrade implies --refresh and uv tool upgrade refreshes; if verbose logs show revalidation of pypi.org/simple/<pkg>/ for both, cut _UV_BACKED_METHODS to {mise-pipx} and adjust tests and CHANGELOG wording.

items.title: uv older than 0.8.20 rejects --force; add a why-comment for --force
items.detail: On uv < 0.8.20 the clean exits non-zero and only a warning is logged. Options: retry without --force when stderr names the flag, or state a uv 0.8.20 floor. Also add one comment line in _refresh_package_index explaining --force (uv run/uvx hold the cache lock). Other LOW items: PRD comment above _UV_BACKED_METHODS, untested non-FileNotFoundError OSError, dead TimeoutExpired/argv lines in test_refresh_index.py, pre-existing >50-line run_update functions.
